rationale: Tier 2 permits only the pull_request route (routes --id 0003 lists exactly one: pull_request, preapproved). The finding is also forced:true with every statistical field null/empty, no failed_run_urls, and no commits in a breach window — a rehearsal of the loop rather than a live regression — so there is nothing for a runbook to act on even if one were available at this tier. The intent PR itself is the diagnosis's whole output; the owner's triage at gate (f) decides whether to merge, schedule, or dismiss it.
